title: Walkable 4BR/Vandy/Broadway/Music Row/Hospital-3
description:
Walk to nearby restaurants, bars and iconic music studios ON MUSIC ROW! Enjoy free parking convenience in the heart of the country music legacy. Vanderbilt and Belmont Universities are walking distance away!
Explore Nashville's heartbeat at our Music Row gem! Fully renovated unit merging classic charm with modern vibes.

* 1.8 miles from downtown Nashville
* 0.8 miles from Vanderbilt Hospital
* 4.2 miles from Nissan Stadium
*1.5 miles from The Gulch

The space
KEY FEATURES:
o Sleeps 10; 4 bedrooms, Bedroom 1 king bed, Bedroom 2 queen bed, Bedroom 2 queen bed, Bedroom 4 queen bed couch turns into sleeper sofa for 2 guests
o 3 full baths (bathroom in master bedroom is a stand up shower, 2 other full baths are tub showers)
o Modern and well equipped kitchen with seating for up to 8 guests
o 2 Gig Fiber WiFi with free YouTube TV. Streaming services available with your login information
o Incredible natural lighting throughout the day
o Blackout curtains in each room for restful sleep during the night

Here Are A Few Kind Words From Past Guests:

o “We had a great stay, great place to walk around everything is close by and the place was very clean and cozy” -Kathy
o “Quiet, clean, comfortable, and an amazing location. I will be staying here again on my next trip to Nashville.” – Jonathon
o “Such a beautiful place!! Everything was spotless and clean. Very close to all the attractions and restaurants. Would highly recommend and would be booking this place again.” -Chey

**BEDROOMS**

The 1st bedroom is equipped with a comfortable king sized bed and smart TV to enjoy your favorite tv shows and movies; guests will also enjoy a private master bathroom. The 2nd, 3rd and 4th bedrooms have comfortable queen beds. Our 'Taylor Swift' inspired room comes with a smart TV as well. The modular couch can easily be turned into a bed that can sleep 2 guests.

**BATHROOM**

There are 4 full bathrooms in the unit fully stocked with all of the toiletries that you need in case you don’t want to bring your own.

**KITCHEN**

The bright and airy kitchen is fully equipped with appliances, cookware and utensils you need to feel at home. The dining room table has seating for 8 guests. Please feel free to use our washer and dryer located in the dining area. It is stocked with detergent for our guests who plan to stay longer than a few days!

**OUTSIDE SPACE**

Unwind in your hidden retreat! A private patio beckons right outside your unit, a secluded haven for tranquil moments. Journey to the shared back patio, thoughtfully furnished for relaxation and playful camaraderie. Your getaway promises a blend of serenity and shared joy, creating lasting memories in this urban sanctuary.

***Book Today & Let Us Take Care Of You In Nashville***

Guest access
Self-check-in with keyless electric lock codes, to ensure safety for all guests. Full access to the entire unit, no shared spaces within the unit. Guests will also have access to 2 free parking spaces behind the building.

Other things to note
Self-check-in with keyless electric lock codes, to ensure safety for all guests. Full access to the entire unit, no shared spaces within the unit. Guests will also have access to 2 free parking space behind the building. Additional street parking in front of the building is free on the weekends. Sometimes we can accommodate additional parking so if you have issues with parking, just let us know!
Please be sure to review the additional house rules listed at the bottom of this page for important information and requirements related to booking this property.
